business_summary.text: HealthCare Global Enterprises is an oncology-focused hospital chain with 26 hospitals across India and Kenya, providing comprehensive cancer care including radiation, medical and surgical oncology.

call_points.text: No FY27 revenue or margin guidance given; the only forward target is 1,000 beds by FY30.
Adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 19.4% from 18.2%, driven by better quality of revenue.
Rights issue completed, strengthening the balance sheet and funding future growth.
West ARPP was flat as higher medical oncology share and lower high-value therapies offset payor-mix gains.

guidance.statement: Target 1,000 beds by FY30, led by 60% brownfield expansion

operating_notes.text: Q1FY27 in-patient volume was 78,914, up 11% YoY, with ARPP of ₹85,943, up 2%.
Non-institutional payor mix rose to 69% in Q1FY27 from 67% in Q1FY26.
North Bengaluru hospital had 56 operational beds and contributed ₹6.7 Cr revenue in its first quarter.

timeline.summary: Sunu Manuel, CFO of Healthcare Global Enterprises Limited, hosted an earnings call on May 20, 2026, discussing audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26.
Q1FY27 (Aug 6, 2026): HCG reported 13% YoY revenue growth to ₹695 Cr and adjusted EBITDA margin of 19.4%, with 121 operational beds added including 56 at the new North Bengaluru hospital.
